name: Gianni Infantino
quote: We have to unite. We have to bring people together. [May 1, 2026 — FIFA Congress, Vancouver: Infantino confirmed Iran WILL play all three group-stage matches on US soil, directly overriding Iran Sports Minister's 'under no circumstances' statement. Iran's federation president was absent — denied entry to Canada the previous day due to alleged IRGC ties.] Earlier: Iran is coming for sure. [CNBC Invest in America Forum, April 2026.] The FIFA Council in Vancouver approved the record $871M total financial contribution for 2026 on April 29. FIFA's VIP motorcade request for Infantino was denied by Vancouver Police, which ruled he does not qualify as an Internationally Protected Person.

name: Donald Trump
role: President of the United States (Host Nation)
quote: The Iran National Soccer Team is welcome to The World Cup, but I really don't believe it is appropriate that they be there, for their own life and safety.

name: Claudia Sheinbaum
quote: Mexico would be open to hosting Iran's World Cup matches if FIFA decides to relocate them. We are a welcoming country and we want all nations to be able to participate in this tournament.

name: Mark Carney
quote: It is the number one sport for Canadian boys and girls. Two-thirds of the country watched the last World Cup and we are partnered with the United States and Mexico, welcoming the world.

name: Victor Montagliani
quote: The 2026 World Cup in North America will be the most transformational event in the history of our confederation. We are ready to show the world what this region can do.

name: Cindy Parlow Cone
quote: The World Cup coming to the United States is a once-in-a-generation opportunity to grow the game across our country. Our federation has never been better prepared.

name: Mauricio Pochettino
quote: The Belgium and Portugal results gave us clear information about what we need to fix. We are 70 days out. The roster announcement is May 26 and we will be ready. The World Cup is a completely different environment from a friendly.

name: Jesús Gutiérrez
quote: We are committed to delivering a world-class experience for all fans. Mexico has hosted the World Cup twice and we know what it takes to do it right.

name: Nick Bontis
quote: This World Cup will be a transformational moment for football in Canada, inspiring the next generation of players and proving that Canada belongs on the world stage.

name: Jamil Dakwar
role: ACLU Human Rights Director (Civil Liberties Advocate)
quote: With less than 100 days until kick-off, the escalating attacks on immigrants in the United States, lack of clear safeguards at stadiums against abusive federal immigration enforcement, and FIFA's cancellation of anti-discrimination messaging signal a tournament heading in the wrong direction.

name: Lionel Messi
role: Argentina Captain / Inter Miami CF Forward (Confirmed in Provisional Squad — Final Cut Pending)
quote: I hope I can be there. I've said before that I'd love to be there. At worst, I'll be there watching it live, but it will be special. The World Cup is special for everyone — especially for us, because we live it in a completely different way. [May 11, 2026 UPDATE: Messi CONFIRMED in Argentina's 55-man provisional squad released today. Final 26-man squad announced May 30; FIFA publishes all squads June 2. Group J: Algeria, Austria, Jordan — Kansas City. Adidas 'El Último Tango' boots widely read as his farewell. 31 days to kickoff.]

name: Kylian Mbappé
quote: France comes with the ambition to win. We have a complete squad, experienced players, and the hunger to bring the trophy back to Paris. [May 14, 2026 UPDATE: Mbappé CONFIRMED in Deschamps' final 26-man France squad despite hamstring management by Real Madrid's medical staff — he missed El Clásico (May 10) but is expected fit for the tournament. France open Group I vs Iraq June 15. 27 days to kickoff.]

name: Lionel Scaloni
quote: Messi will take this time calmly before making a final decision. He always tells me that he would like me to be there in any role. We have a relationship of great trust and we can talk about everything. [May 11, 2026: Argentina's 55-man provisional squad released — Messi leads the list. Garnacho returns; Dybala, Correa, six Qatar 2022 winners omitted. Final 26-man squad announced May 30.]

name: Thomas Tuchel
quote: We have 26 one-hundred per cent committed players… we don't want to be shy about it — the goal is to try and win it. [May 22, 2026 SQUAD ANNOUNCED at Wembley: Harry Kane captains for a third World Cup (equalling Billy Wright's record). Full squad: GK: D. Henderson, Pickford, Trafford. DEF: Burn, Guéhi, R. James, Konsa, Livramento, O'Reilly, Quansah, Spence, Stones. MID: E. Anderson, Bellingham, Eze, Henderson, Mainoo, Rice, M. Rogers. FWD: Gordon, Kane, Madueke, Rashford, Saka, Ivan Toney, Watkins. Notable omissions: Cole Palmer, Phil Foden, Trent Alexander-Arnold, Harry Maguire (said he was 'shocked and gutted'). Toney recalled as surprise. Jordan Henderson: record-tying 4th World Cup (=Charlton). 9 debutants. Group L: Croatia, Ghana, Panama. 20 days to kickoff.]

name: Didier Deschamps
role: France Head Coach (Final Tournament — Stepping Down After 2026)
quote: We prepare meticulously for every tournament. France's goal is always the same: to win. [May 14, 2026 UPDATE: Deschamps announced his final 26-man France squad in Paris — confirmed as his last tournament as Les Bleus head coach after a tenure beginning in 2012 that delivered the 2018 World Cup. Kylian Mbappé confirmed as captain despite hamstring management. Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) and Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) excluded. Hugo Ekitike (Achilles) out. Rayan Cherki, Desire Doue, Michael Olise, Jean-Philippe Mateta among the fresh faces. France open Group I vs Iraq June 15. 27 days to kickoff.]

name: Mehdi Taj
quote: Our host is FIFA, not Mr. Trump or America. [May 20, 2026 UPDATE: The decisive FIFA-Infantino-Taj Zurich summit concluded today — Taj confirmed FIFA 'listened to Iran's arguments, the ten points we raised, and offered solutions for each one.' FIFA reaffirmed Iran's full participation. May 21: Iran squad players physically traveled to the US Embassy in Ankara to submit visa applications — the first concrete step after the summit. No visas yet approved. June 1 squad deadline is 11 days away. Warm-up: vs Gambia, Antalya, May 29. Group G schedule unchanged: SoFi LA (June 15 vs NZ, June 21 vs Belgium), Lumen Seattle (June 26 vs Egypt). 21 days to kickoff.]

name: Ahmad Donyamali
role: Iran Minister of Sport and Youth
quote: Under no circumstances can [Iran] participate in this World Cup. [April 30, 2026 — issued hours after Iran's federation president Mehdi Taj was denied entry to Canada at Toronto Pearson Airport and barred from the FIFA Congress. Iran's warm-up friendlies were simultaneously cancelled. On May 1, FIFA President Infantino overrode this position at the Vancouver Congress, confirming Iran's participation under FIFA's governance framework — which recognizes football federations, not government ministries. The June 1 squad submission deadline is the next hard decision point for whether Iran's government will allow the federation to comply with FIFA's confirmation.]

name: Timothy Weah
quote: The ticket prices are too expensive. Lots of real fans will miss matches. Football should still be enjoyed by everyone.

name: Christian Pulisic
quote: I think you could say so — this is the strongest squad I've been part of. Looking at the guys playing at the highest levels and doing extremely well at their clubs, you have a really, really strong squad and depth as well. Multiple guys that can play in every position. The team's in a good place. People should be excited and hopefully ready to cheer us on. [April 21, 2026, Reuters]

name: Marco Rubio
quote: Nothing from the US has told them they can't come. The problem with Iran would be not their athletes. It would be some of the other people they would want to bring with them, some of whom have ties to the IRGC. They can't bring a bunch of IRGC terrorists into our country and pretend that they are journalists and athletic trainers. [April 24, 2026, on Iran's World Cup participation]

name: Hajime Moriyasu
quote: It's a huge blow. [May 15, 2026 — on Kaoru Mitoma's omission from Japan's final 26-man World Cup squad due to a hamstring injury. Moriyasu named his squad in Tokyo on May 15. Notable: Takehiro Tomiyasu returns after a nearly two-year international absence; Yuto Nagatomo selected for a fifth World Cup. Japan in Group F: vs Netherlands (June 14, Arlington), Tunisia (June 21, Guadalajara), Sweden (June 25, Arlington). 27 days to kickoff.]

name: Son Heung-min
role: South Korea Captain / Tottenham Hotspur Forward (Confirmed in 26-Man Squad — May 16)
quote: Playing in the World Cup for my country is always a great privilege and responsibility. We will give everything for the people of Korea. [May 16, 2026 — confirmed as captain of South Korea's 26-man World Cup squad announced by coach Hong Myung-bo in Seoul. Squad also features Kim Min-jae (Bayern Munich), Lee Kang-in (PSG), and Jens Castrop — first dual German-Korean heritage player in Taeguk Warriors history. 26 days to kickoff.]

name: Hong Myung-bo
quote: Our goal is to reach the round of 16 as a minimum. We have quality players in Europe's top leagues. [May 16, 2026 — announced South Korea's 26-man World Cup roster in Seoul. Son Heung-min captains; Jens Castrop becomes the first German-Korean dual-heritage player named to South Korea — a historic milestone. Kim Min-jae (Bayern Munich) and Lee Kang-in (PSG) included. Hwang In-beom selected despite ankle injury. 26 days to kickoff.]

name: Cristiano Ronaldo
role: Portugal Captain / Al Nassr Forward (Record Sixth World Cup — History's First Six-Time Participant)
quote: I never stop believing. Age is just a number. This will be the most special World Cup of my life. [May 19, 2026 — confirmed by coach Roberto Martinez in Portugal's 26-man World Cup squad; Ronaldo (41) becomes the first player in history to compete at six FIFA World Cups. Portugal in Group K: vs DR Congo (June 18), Colombia (June 22), Uzbekistan (June 27). The squad includes a 27th honorary place for the late Diogo Jota. 23 days to kickoff.]

name: Roberto Martínez
quote: Ronaldo is in the squad. He showed the quality and experience we need. He is part of our history and will be part of this World Cup chapter. The 27th honorary place for Diogo shows what this squad means — as a family. [May 19, 2026 — Martínez announced Portugal's 26-man World Cup squad in Lisbon, confirming Ronaldo for a record sixth World Cup and adding a symbolic honorary 27th spot for the late Diogo Jota. Group K: DR Congo (June 18), Colombia (June 22), Uzbekistan (June 27). 23 days to kickoff.]

name: Steve Clarke
role: Scotland Head Coach (First World Cup Since 1998 — 28-Year Return)
quote: This squad represents everything Scottish football has worked for. We've earned this — Scotland are back on the world stage and we go there to compete. [May 19, 2026 — Clarke named Scotland's 26-man World Cup squad, the nation's first since France 1998. Captain Andy Robertson (92 caps, Liverpool) leads alongside Scott McTominay (Napoli), John McGinn (Aston Villa), and Ché Adams (Torino). Group C: vs Haiti (June 14, Foxborough), Morocco (June 20), Brazil (June 25). 23 days to kickoff.]

name: Julian Nagelsmann
quote: Manuel Neuer is one of the greatest goalkeepers of all time. He earned his place — I needed to know he was ready and he is. [May 21, 2026 — Nagelsmann announced Germany's 26-man World Cup squad, with the defining story being Manuel Neuer's (40) return from international retirement as first-choice goalkeeper. Joshua Kimmich captains; Jamal Musiala, Florian Wirtz lead the attack; Rüdiger, Tah, Anton, Thiaw in defence. Notable omissions: Gnabry (injury), Füllkrug, Adeyemi. Germany in Group E: Curaçao (June 14, Houston), Ivory Coast (June 20, Toronto), Ecuador (June 25, MetLife NJ). 21 days to kickoff.]

name: Carlo Ancelotti
quote: Neymar is in the squad. He showed in the last weeks his condition has improved — we believe in him. [May 18, 2026 — Ancelotti announced Brazil's final 26-man World Cup squad at the Museum of Tomorrow in Rio de Janeiro. Neymar confirmed despite an emotional pre-announcement controversy when Santos accidentally substituted him at halftime on May 17. Key inclusions: Neymar (Santos), Vinicius Junior, Endrick (Real Madrid), Matheus Cunha (Man City), Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle), Gabriel Magalhaes (Arsenal), Joao Pedro, Lucas Paquetá (West Ham). Absences: Rodrygo (ACL), Eder Militão (hamstring), Estevao (hamstring). 24 days to kickoff.]
